Advertising is coming to Apple Maps in the US and Canada, with businesses able to book ad slots starting today. Here's what you need to know, including a limited-time promotion.

Businesses can now book Apple Maps ads starting today

If you run a business and want to advertise on Apple Maps, bookings are now officially open.

Users won't see ads rolling out just yet, but Apple is preparing for a full launch and letting businesses reserve ad space from now on.

Full details on booking ads have been published on the Apple website, including step-by-step instructions on how to get started.

Apple is also running a special limited-time offer — here are the details:

The offer applies to eligible businesses that book a Maps ad with a credit card by 11 October 2026.

As reported earlier this year, ads will appear in two places within Apple Maps:

  • Before search: businesses' ads will show up in the "suggested places" section of the search screen.
  • After search: ads will appear within search results when they're relevant to what users are looking for.

If you're thinking about advertising on Apple Maps, Apple has also set up a dedicated page explaining its approach to ads — see it here.

Apple says more than one billion business-related searches take place on Apple Maps every month, and one in two searches for a business leads to an action. According to the GWI Core Study Q1 2025, Gen Z and Millennials make up 57% of Apple Maps users.
